/- 13. [9] Suppose $x, y$, and $z$ are real numbers greater than 1 such that

$$

\begin{aligned}
x^{\log _{y} z} & =2, \\
y^{\log _{y} x} & =4, \text { and } \\
z^{\log _{x} y} & =8 .
\end{aligned}

$$


Compute $\log _{x} y$. -/
theorem algebra_182922 (x y z : ℝ) (hx : 1 < x) (hy : 1 < y) (hz : 1 < z)
    (h₁ : x ^ Real.logb y z = 2) (h₂ : y ^ Real.logb z x = 4) (h₃ : z ^ Real.logb x y = 8) :
    Real.logb x y = Real.sqrt 3 := by
formal_proof:
import Mathlib

theorem algebra_182922 (x y z : ℝ) (hx : 1 < x) (hy : 1 < y) (hz : 1 < z)
    (h₁ : x ^ Real.logb y z = 2) (h₂ : y ^ Real.logb z x = 4) (h₃ : z ^ Real.logb x y = 8) :
    Real.logb x y = Real.sqrt 3 := by
  have h4 : Real.logb y z * Real.log x = Real.log 2 := by
    have h5 : Real.log (x ^ Real.logb y z) = Real.log 2 := by
      rw [h₁]
      all_goals linarith
    have h6 : Real.log (x ^ Real.logb y z) = Real.logb y z * Real.log x := by
      rw [Real.log_rpow]
      all_goals linarith
    linarith [h5, h6]
  have h7 : Real.logb z x * Real.log y = Real.log 4 := by
    have h8 : Real.log (y ^ Real.logb z x) = Real.log 4 := by
      rw [h₂]
      all_goals linarith
    have h9 : Real.log (y ^ Real.logb z x) = Real.logb z x * Real.log y := by
      rw [Real.log_rpow]
      all_goals linarith
    linarith [h8, h9]
  have h10 : Real.logb x y * Real.log z = Real.log 8 := by
    have h11 : Real.log (z ^ Real.logb x y) = Real.log 8 := by
      rw [h₃]
      all_goals linarith
    have h12 : Real.log (z ^ Real.logb x y) = Real.logb x y * Real.log z := by
      rw [Real.log_rpow]
      all_goals linarith
    linarith [h11, h12]
  have h_eq1 : Real.logb y z = Real.log z / Real.log y := by
    field_simp [Real.logb]
  have h_eq2 : Real.logb z x = Real.log x / Real.log z := by
    field_simp [Real.logb]
  have h_eq3 : Real.logb x y = Real.log y / Real.log x := by
    field_simp [Real.logb]
  have h11 : Real.log 4 = 2 * Real.log 2 := by
    calc
      Real.log 4 = Real.log (2 ^ 2 : ℝ) := by norm_num
      _ = 2 * Real.log (2 : ℝ) := by simp [Real.log_pow]
  have h12 : Real.log 8 = 3 * Real.log 2 := by
    calc
      Real.log 8 = Real.log (2 ^ 3 : ℝ) := by norm_num
      _ = 3 * Real.log (2 : ℝ) := by simp [Real.log_pow]
  rw [h_eq1] at h4
  rw [h_eq2] at h7
  rw [h_eq3] at h10
  rw [h11] at h7
  rw [h12] at h10
  have hx_pos : 0 < Real.log x := by
    apply Real.log_pos
    linarith
  have hy_pos : 0 < Real.log y := by
    apply Real.log_pos
    linarith
  have hz_pos : 0 < Real.log z := by
    apply Real.log_pos
    linarith
  have h_eq4 : (Real.log y) ^ 2 = 3 * (Real.log x) ^ 2 := by
    field_simp [show Real.log y ≠ 0 by linarith, show Real.log z ≠ 0 by linarith] at h4 h7 h10
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (Real.log x - Real.log y), sq_nonneg (Real.log y - Real.log z), sq_nonneg (Real.log z - Real.log x)]
  have h_eq5 : (Real.log y / Real.log x) ^ 2 = 3 := by
    have hx_pos' : 0 < Real.log x := hx_pos
    field_simp at *
    nlinarith
  have h_eq6 : Real.logb x y = Real.sqrt 3 := by
    rw [h_eq3]
    have h11 : (Real.log y / Real.log x) ^ 2 = 3 := h_eq5
    have h_eq7 : Real.log y / Real.log x = Real.sqrt 3 := by
      have h14 : (Real.log y / Real.log x) ^ 2 = 3 := h_eq5
      have h15 : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt 3 := by positivity
      have h_eq8 : Real.log y / Real.log x ≥ 0 := by
        have h16 : Real.log y / Real.log x > 0 := by
          apply div_pos
          all_goals linarith
        linarith
      have h_eq9 : Real.log y / Real.log x = Real.sqrt 3 := by
        have h_eq10 : (Real.log y / Real.log x) ^ 2 - 3 = 0 := by linarith
        have h_eq11 : (Real.log y / Real.log x - Real.sqrt 3) * (Real.log y / Real.log x + Real.sqrt 3) = 0 := by
          nlinarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg 3, Real.sq_sqrt (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ 3 by norm_num)]
        cases' (mul_eq_zero.mp h_eq11) with h_eq12 h_eq13
        · -- $\log_{x} y - \sqrt{3} = 0$
          linarith
        · -- $\log_{x} y + \sqrt{3} = 0$
          nlinarith [Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (show (0 : ℝ) < (3 : ℝ) by norm_num : (3 : ℝ) > 0)]
      linarith
    field_simp at h_eq7 ⊢
    <;> nlinarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg 3, Real.sq_sqrt (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ (3 : ℝ) by norm_num)]
  linarith [h_eq6]

$$
1<\frac{a}{a+1}+\frac{b}{b+1}+\frac{c}{c+1}<2 .

theorem inequalities_300753 {a b c : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (hc : 0 < c)
    (h : logb 10 a + logb 10 b + logb 10 c = 0) :

import Mathlib

theorem inequalities_300753 {a b c : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (hc : 0 < c)
    (h : logb 10 a + logb 10 b + logb 10 c = 0) :
    1 < a / (a + 1) + b / (b + 1) + c / (c + 1) ∧
    a / (a + 1) + b / (b + 1) + c / (c + 1) < 2 := by
  have h1 : a * b * c = 1 := by
    have h2 : logb 10 a + logb 10 b + logb 10 c = logb 10 (a * b * c) := by
      simp [logb_mul, ha.ne.symm, hb.ne.symm, hc.ne.symm]
      all_goals nlinarith
    rw [h2] at h
    have h4 : logb 10 (a * b * c) = 0 := h
    have h5 : a * b * c > 0 := by positivity
    have h6 : (a * b * c) = (10 : ℝ) ^ (0 : ℝ) := by
      rw [logb_eq_iff_rpow_eq (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by positivity)] at h4
      all_goals nlinarith
    have h8 : (10 : ℝ) ^ (0 : ℝ) = 1 := by
      norm_num
    rw [h8] at h6
    linarith
  constructor
  · -- Show that 1 < a / (a + 1) + b / (b + 1) + c / (c + 1)
    have h2 : a / (a + 1) + b / (b + 1) + c / (c + 1) - 1 > 0 := by
      have h3 : a / (a + 1) + b / (b + 1) + c / (c + 1) - 1 =
          (a * (b + 1) * (c + 1) + b * (a + 1) * (c + 1) + c * (a + 1) * (b + 1) - (a + 1) * (b + 1) * (c + 1)) / ((a + 1) * (b + 1) * (c + 1)) := by
        field_simp
        ring
      rw [h3]
      have h4 : a * (b + 1) * (c + 1) + b * (a + 1) * (c + 1) + c * (a + 1) * (b + 1) - (a + 1) * (b + 1) * (c + 1) > 0 := by
        nlinarith [sq_nonneg (a - 1), sq_nonneg (b - 1), sq_nonneg (c - 1), 
          sq_nonneg (a * b - 1), sq_nonneg (b * c - 1), sq_nonneg (a * c - 1),

theorem algebra_237041 {f : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ} (hf1 : ∀ x, f 1 x = -(2 * x + 7) / (x + 3))

The solution sets of these inequalities are denoted as $A$ and $B$ respectively. Find the range of values for $a$ that makes $A \subseteq B$. -/
theorem inequalities_131222 {a : ℝ} (A B : Set ℝ)
  (hA : A = {x | abs (x - (a + 1)^2 / 2) ≤ (a - 1)^2 / 2})
  (hB : B = {x | x^2 - 3 * (a + 1) * x + 2 * (3 * a + 1) ≤ 0}) :

formal_proof:

open Real Set

theorem inequalities_131222 {a : ℝ} (A B : Set ℝ)
  (hA : A = {x | abs (x - (a + 1)^2 / 2) ≤ (a - 1)^2 / 2})
  (hB : B = {x | x^2 - 3 * (a + 1) * x + 2 * (3 * a + 1) ≤ 0}) :
  A ⊆ B ↔ 1 ≤ a ∧ a ≤ 3 ∨ a = -1 := by
  rw [hA, hB]
  constructor
  · -- First direction
    intro h
    have h1 : (2 * a) ^ 2 - 3 * (a + 1) * (2 * a) + 2 * (3 * a + 1) ≤ 0 := by
      apply h
      dsimp
      rw [abs_le]
      constructor <;> nlinarith [sq_nonneg (a ^ 2 - 2 * a), sq_nonneg (a - 1)]
    have h2 : (a^2 + 1) ^ 2 - 3 * (a + 1) * (a^2 + 1) + 2 * (3 * a + 1) ≤ 0 := by
      apply h
      dsimp
      rw [abs_le]
      constructor <;> nlinarith [sq_nonneg (a ^ 2 - 2 * a), sq_nonneg (a - 1)]
    have h3 : a^2 ≥ 1 := by
      nlinarith
    by_cases h4 : 1 ≤ a
    · -- If 1 ≤ a
      have h5 : a ≤ 3 := by
        nlinarith [sq_nonneg (a ^ 2 - 3 * a), sq_nonneg (a - 1), sq_nonneg (a - 3), sq_nonneg (2 * a), sq_nonneg (a^2 - 3 * a - 1)]
      left
      constructor <;> linarith
    · -- If not 1 ≤ a
      have h5 : a < 1 := by linarith
      have h6 : a ≤ -1 := by nlinarith
      have h3 : (a + 1) * (a - 1) ≥ 0 := by nlinarith
      have h4 : a ^ 2 + 1 ≤ 2 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (a ^ 2 - 3 * a), sq_nonneg (a - 1), sq_nonneg (a - 3), sq_nonneg (2 * a), sq_nonneg (a^2 - 3 * a - 1)]
      have h5 : a ≥ -1 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (a - 1), sq_nonneg (a + 1)]
      have h6 : a = -1 := by nlinarith
      right
      linarith
  · -- Second direction
    rintro (h | h)
    · -- Case where 1 ≤ a ∧ a ≤ 3
      rcases h with ⟨h1, h2⟩
      intro x hx
      dsimp at hx ⊢
      rw [abs_le] at hx
      have h3 : 2 * a ≤ x := by nlinarith
      have h4 : x ≤ a^2 + 1 := by nlinarith
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (x - 2), sq_nonneg (x - (3 * a + 1)), sq_nonneg (a - 1), sq_nonneg (a - 3)]
    · -- Case where a = -1
      intro x hx
      dsimp at hx ⊢
      rw [abs_le] at hx
      have h3 : -2 ≤ x := by nlinarith
      have h4 : x ≤ 2 := by nlinarith
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (x - 2), sq_nonneg (x - (3 * a + 1)), sq_nonneg (a + 1)]

theorem number_theory_257025 (n : ℕ) (hn : n > 0) :
    5 ∣ 1^n + 2^n + 3^n + 4^n ↔ ¬4 ∣ n := by
  constructor
  · -- Forward direction: If 5 divides 1^n + 2^n + 3^n + 4^n, then ¬4 divides n
    intro h
    by_contra h1
    -- Assume 4 divides n, we need to show contradiction in 5 dividing the sum
    have h2 : 4 ∣ n := h1
    rcases h2 with ⟨k, hk⟩
    rw [show n = 4 * k by omega] at h
    have h3 : (1 ^ (4 * k) + 2 ^ (4 * k) + 3 ^ (4 * k) + 4 ^ (4 * k) : ℕ) % 5 = 4 := by
      have h11 : ∀ k : ℕ, (1 ^ (4 * k) + 2 ^ (4 * k) + 3 ^ (4 * k) + 4 ^ (4 * k) : ℕ) % 5 = 4 := by
        intro k
        induction k with
        | zero => 
          simp
        | succ k ih =>
          simp [Nat.pow_add, Nat.pow_mul, Nat.pow_mul] at ih ⊢
          all_goals omega
      specialize h11 k
      simpa using h11
    have h4 : 5 ∣ (1 ^ (4 * k) + 2 ^ (4 * k) + 3 ^ (4 * k) + 4 ^ (4 * k) : ℕ) := by
      simpa using h
    omega
  · -- Backward direction: If ¬4 divides n, then 5 divides 1^n + 2^n + 3^n + 4^n
    intro h
    have h6 : n % 4 = 1 ∨ n % 4 = 2 ∨ n % 4 = 3 := by
      omega

    · -- Case n % 4 = 1
      have h11 : (1 ^ n + 2 ^ n + 3 ^ n + 4 ^ n) % 5 = 0 := by
        have h111 : ∀ k : ℕ, (1 ^ (4 * k + 1) + 2 ^ (4 * k + 1) + 3 ^ (4 * k + 1) + 4 ^ (4 * k + 1) : ℕ) % 5 = 0 := by

        rcases h112 with ⟨k, h113⟩

    · -- Case n % 4 = 3

        have h111 : ∀ k : ℕ, (1 ^ (4 * k + 3) + 2 ^ (4 * k + 3) + 3 ^ (4 * k + 3) + 4 ^ (4 * k + 3) : ℕ) % 5 = 0 := by

/- Let $a,b,c,d$ be positive real numbers. Prove that
\[\frac{a}{b+2c+3d}+\frac{b}{c+2d+3a}+\frac{c}{d+2a+3b}+\frac{d}{a+2b+3c} \geq \frac{2}{3}.\] -/
theorem inequalities_75015 (a b c d : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (hc : 0 < c) (hd : 0 < d) :
    a / (b + 2 * c + 3 * d) + b / (c + 2 * d + 3 * a) +
    c / (d + 2 * a + 3 * b) + d / (a + 2 * b + 3 * c) ≥ 2 / 3 := by

import Mathlib

theorem inequalities_75015 (a b c d : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (hc : 0 < c) (hd : 0 < d) :
    a / (b + 2 * c + 3 * d) + b / (c + 2 * d + 3 * a) +
    c / (d + 2 * a + 3 * b) + d / (a + 2 * b + 3 * c) ≥ 2 / 3 := by
  have h1 : 0 < b + 2 * c + 3 * d := by
    positivity

  have h2 : 0 < c + 2 * d + 3 * a := by
    positivity

  have h3 : 0 < d + 2 * a + 3 * b := by
    positivity

  have h4 : 0 < a + 2 * b + 3 * c := by
    positivity
  have h5 : a / (b + 2 * c + 3 * d) + b / (c + 2 * d + 3 * a) + c / (d + 2 * a + 3 * b) + d / (a + 2 * b + 3 * c) - 2 / 3 ≥ 0 := by
    have h7 : 0 < (b + 2 * c + 3 * d) * (c + 2 * d + 3 * a) * (d + 2 * a + 3 * b) * (a + 2 * b + 3 * c) := by
      positivity
    have h8 : a / (b + 2 * c + 3 * d) + b / (c + 2 * d + 3 * a) + c / (d + 2 * a + 3 * b) + d / (a + 2 * b + 3 * c) - 2 / 3 =
        (a * (c + 2 * d + 3 * a) * (d + 2 * a + 3 * b) * (a + 2 * b + 3 * c) +
            b * (b + 2 * c + 3 * d) * (d + 2 * a + 3 * b) * (a + 2 * b + 3 * c) +
            c * (b + 2 * c + 3 * d) * (c + 2 * d + 3 * a) * (a + 2 * b + 3 * c) +
            d * (b + 2 * c + 3 * d) * (c + 2 * d + 3 * a) * (d + 2 * a + 3 * b) -
            2 / 3 * (b + 2 * c + 3 * d) * (c + 2 * d + 3 * a) * (d + 2 * a + 3 * b) * (a + 2 * b + 3 * c)
        ) / ((b + 2 * c + 3 * d) * (c + 2 * d + 3 * a) * (d + 2 * a + 3 * b) * (a + 2 * b + 3 * c)) := by
      field_simp
      ring
    rw [h8] at *
    apply div_nonneg

/- Alice is thinking of a positive real number $x$, and Bob is thinking of a positive real number $y$.
Given that $x^{\sqrt{y}}=27$ and $(\sqrt{x})^{y}=9$, compute $x y$. -/
theorem algebra_610538{x y: ℝ}(xpos: 0 < x)(ypos: 0 < y)
  (h1: x^(√y) = 27)(h2: (√x)^y = 9):
  x*y = 16 * (3:ℝ)^(1/4:ℝ) := by
formal_proof:
import Mathlib

theorem algebra_610538{x y: ℝ}(xpos: 0 < x)(ypos: 0 < y)
  (h1: x^(√y) = 27)(h2: (√x)^y = 9):
  x*y = 16 * (3:ℝ)^(1/4:ℝ) := by

  have eq1 : (√y) * (Real.log x) = 3 * (Real.log 3) := by
    have h3 : Real.log ((x : ℝ) ^ (√y)) = Real.log (27 : ℝ) := by
      rw [h1]
    have h4 : Real.log ((x : ℝ) ^ (√y)) = (√y) * Real.log x := by
      rw [Real.log_rpow]
      all_goals linarith
    have h5 : Real.log (27 : ℝ) = 3 * (Real.log 3) := by
      calc
        Real.log (27 : ℝ) = Real.log ((3 : ℝ) ^ 3) := by norm_num
        _ = 3 * (Real.log 3) := by simp [Real.log_pow]
    rw [h4, h5] at h3
    linarith

  have eq2 : (y / 2) * (Real.log x) = 2 * (Real.log 3) := by
    have h6 : Real.log ((√x : ℝ) ^ y) = Real.log (9 : ℝ) := by
      rw [h2]
    have h7 : Real.log ((√x : ℝ) ^ y) = y * Real.log (√x) := by
      rw [Real.log_rpow]
      all_goals
        positivity
    have h8 : Real.log (√x) = (1 / 2) * Real.log x := by
      have h9 : Real.log (√x) = Real.log ((x) ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ)) := by
        rw [Real.sqrt_eq_rpow]
      have h10 : Real.log ((x) ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ)) = (1 / 2) * Real.log x := by
        rw [Real.log_rpow]
        all_goals linarith
      rw [h9, h10]
    have h11 : Real.log (9 : ℝ) = 2 * (Real.log 3) := by
      calc
        Real.log (9 : ℝ) = Real.log ((3 : ℝ) ^ 2) := by norm_num
        _ = 2 * (Real.log 3) := by simp [Real.log_pow]
    rw [h7, h8, h11] at h6
    nlinarith

  have h12 : Real.log 3 > 0 := by
    apply Real.log_pos
    all_goals norm_num

  have eq3 : Real.log x = 9 / 4 * (Real.log 3) := by
    have eq5 : y * (Real.log x) ^ 2 = 9 * (Real.log 3) ^ 2 := by
      have h8 : ( (√y) * (Real.log x) ) ^ 2 = y * (Real.log x) ^ 2 := by
        calc
          ( (√y) * (Real.log x) ) ^ 2 = (√y) ^ 2 * (Real.log x) ^ 2 := by ring
          _ = y * (Real.log x) ^ 2 := by
            have h10 : (√y) ^ 2 = y := by
              rw [Real.sq_sqrt]
              linarith
            rw [h10]
      have h11 : ( (√y) * (Real.log x) ) ^ 2 = (3 * (Real.log 3)) ^ 2 := by
        rw [eq1]
      have h12 : (3 * (Real.log 3)) ^ 2 = 9 * (Real.log 3) ^ 2 := by
        nlinarith
      nlinarith [h12, h11, h8]
    have eq6 : y * (Real.log x) = 4 * (Real.log 3) := by
      nlinarith [eq2]
    have h13 : Real.log x ≠ 0 := by
      by_contra h
      rw [h] at eq1
      nlinarith [h12, eq1]

    have eq7' : Real.log x = 9 / 4 * Real.log 3 := by
      apply (mul_left_inj' (show Real.log 3 ≠ 0 by
        linarith [h12]
      )).mp
      nlinarith [eq5, eq6, h12]
    linarith

  have eq4 : Real.sqrt y = 4 / 3 := by
    have h14 : (√y) * (Real.log x) = 3 * (Real.log 3) := eq1
    rw [eq3] at h14
    nlinarith [h12]

  have eq5 : y = 16 / 9 := by
    have h15 : Real.sqrt y = 4 / 3 := eq4
    have h16 : y = (Real.sqrt y) ^ 2 := by
      rw [Real.sq_sqrt]
      all_goals linarith
    rw [h15] at h16
    nlinarith

  have eq9 : x = (3 : ℝ) ^ (9 / 4 : ℝ) := by
    have eq7' : Real.log x = 9 / 4 * Real.log 3 := eq3
    have eq8' : x = Real.exp (Real.log x) := by
      rw [Real.exp_log]
      linarith
    rw [eq8']
    rw [eq7']
    have h14 : Real.exp (9 / 4 * Real.log 3) = (3 : ℝ) ^ (9 / 4 : ℝ) := by
      have h16 : ( (3 : ℝ) ^ (9 / 4 : ℝ) ) = Real.exp ( (9 / 4 : ℝ) * Real.log (3 : ℝ) ) := by
        rw [Real.rpow_def_of_pos]
        field_simp [Real.log_exp]
        all_goals linarith
      linarith [h16]
    linarith [h14]

  have eq7 : x * y = 16 * (3 : ℝ) ^ (1 / 4 : ℝ) := by
    rw [eq9, eq5]
    have eq8 : (3 : ℝ) ^ (9 / 4 : ℝ) * (16 / 9) = 16 * (3 : ℝ) ^ (1 / 4 : ℝ) := by
      have eq9 : (3 : ℝ) ^ (9 / 4 : ℝ) = (3 : ℝ) ^ (2 + 1 / 4 : ℝ) := by norm_num
      have eq10 : (3 : ℝ) ^ (2 + 1 / 4 : ℝ) = (3 : ℝ) ^ (2 : ℝ) * (3 : ℝ) ^ (1 / 4 : ℝ) := by
        rw [← Real.rpow_add]
        norm_num
        all_goals norm_num
      have eq11 : (3 : ℝ) ^ (2 : ℝ) = 9 := by
        norm_num
      rw [eq9, eq10, eq11]
      all_goals
        ring_nf
        all_goals norm_num
    nlinarith [eq8]

  linarith [eq7]

/- 3. Define the function on $\mathbf{R}$
$$
f(x)=\left\{\begin{array}{ll}
\log _{2}(1-x), & x \leqslant 0 ; \\
f(x-1)-f(x-2), & x>0 .
\end{array}\right.
$$

Then $f(2014)=$ -/
theorem algebra_312195 {f : ℝ → ℝ}
    (h₀ : ∀ x, x ≤ 0 → f x = logb 2 (1 - x))
    (h₁ : ∀ x, x > 0 → f x = f (x - 1) - f (x - 2)) :
    f 2014 = 1 := by
formal_proof:
import Mathlib

open Real

theorem algebra_312195 {f : ℝ → ℝ}
    (h₀ : ∀ x, x ≤ 0 → f x = logb 2 (1 - x))
    (h₁ : ∀ x, x > 0 → f x = f (x - 1) - f (x - 2)) :
    f 2014 = 1 := by

  have h2 : f 0 = 0 := by
    specialize h₀ 0 (by norm_num)
    rw [h₀]
    norm_num [logb_eq_iff_rpow_eq]

  have h3 : f (-1 : ℝ) = 1 := by
    specialize h₀ (-1 : ℝ) (by norm_num)
    rw [h₀]
    norm_num [logb_eq_iff_rpow_eq]

  have h4 : f 1 = -1 := by
    specialize h₁ 1 (by norm_num)
    rw [show (1 : ℝ) - 1 = (0 : ℝ) by norm_num, show (1 : ℝ) - 2 = (-1 : ℝ) by norm_num] at h₁
    rw [h₁, h2, h3]
    all_goals norm_num

  have h5 : f 2 = -1 := by
    specialize h₁ 2 (by norm_num)
    rw [show (2 : ℝ) - 1 = (1 : ℝ) by norm_num, show (2 : ℝ) - 2 = (0 : ℝ) by norm_num] at h₁
    rw [h₁, h4, h2]
    all_goals norm_num

  have h6 : f 3 = 0 := by
    specialize h₁ 3 (by norm_num)
    rw [show (3 : ℝ) - 1 = (2 : ℝ) by norm_num, show (3 : ℝ) - 2 = (1 : ℝ) by norm_num] at h₁
    rw [h₁, h5, h4]
    all_goals norm_num

  have h7 : f 4 = 1 := by
    specialize h₁ 4 (by norm_num)
    rw [show (4 : ℝ) - 1 = (3 : ℝ) by norm_num, show (4 : ℝ) - 2 = (2 : ℝ) by norm_num] at h₁
    rw [h₁, h6, h5]
    all_goals norm_num

  have eq4 : ∀ (k : ℕ), f (4 + ↑k * 6 : ℝ) = 1 := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero =>
      norm_num
      all_goals
      linarith [h7]
    | succ m ih =>
      have eq5 : (4 + ↑(m + 1 : ℕ) * 6 : ℝ) = (4 + ↑m * 6 : ℝ) + 6 := by
        simp at *
        <;> ring
      rw [eq5]
      have h14 : ∀ x > 0, f (x + 6 : ℝ) = f x := by
        intro x hx
        have eq5 : f (x + 6 : ℝ) = f (x + 5 : ℝ) - f (x + 4 : ℝ) := by
          specialize h₁ (x + 6 : ℝ) (by linarith)
          rw [show (x + 6 : ℝ) - 1 = x + 5 by ring, show (x + 6 : ℝ) - 2 = x + 4 by ring] at h₁
          linarith
        have eq6 : f (x + 5 : ℝ) = f (x + 4 : ℝ) - f (x + 3 : ℝ) := by
          specialize h₁ (x + 5 : ℝ) (by linarith)
          rw [show (x + 5 : ℝ) - 1 = x + 4 by ring, show (x + 5 : ℝ) - 2 = x + 3 by ring] at h₁
          linarith
        have eq7 : f (x + 4 : ℝ) = f (x + 3 : ℝ) - f (x + 2 : ℝ) := by
          specialize h₁ (x + 4 : ℝ) (by linarith)
          rw [show (x + 4 : ℝ) - 1 = x + 3 by ring, show (x + 4 : ℝ) - 2 = x + 2 by ring] at h₁
          linarith
        have eq8 : f (x + 3 : ℝ) = f (x + 2 : ℝ) - f (x + 1 : ℝ) := by
          specialize h₁ (x + 3 : ℝ) (by linarith)
          rw [show (x + 3 : ℝ) - 1 = x + 2 by ring, show (x + 3 : ℝ) - 2 = x + 1 by ring] at h₁
          linarith
        have eq9 : f (x + 2 : ℝ) = f (x + 1 : ℝ) - f (x : ℝ) := by
          specialize h₁ (x + 2 : ℝ) (by linarith)
          rw [show (x + 2 : ℝ) - 1 = x + 1 by ring, show (x + 2 : ℝ) - 2 = x by ring] at h₁
          linarith
        have eq10 : f (x + 1 : ℝ) = f (x : ℝ) - f (x - 1 : ℝ) := by
          specialize h₁ (x + 1 : ℝ) (by linarith)
          rw [show (x + 1 : ℝ) - 1 = x by ring, show (x + 1 : ℝ) - 2 = x - 1 by ring] at h₁
          linarith
        have eq12 : f (x + 6 : ℝ) = f x := by
          nlinarith [eq5, eq6, eq7, eq8, eq9, eq10]
        exact_mod_cast eq12
      have eq13 : f ((4 + ↑m * 6 : ℝ) + 6 : ℝ) = f (4 + ↑m * 6 : ℝ) := by
        specialize h14 (4 + ↑m * 6 : ℝ) (by
          positivity
        )
        simpa using h14
      rw [eq13, ih]
      all_goals norm_num
  -- Compute 2014 as 4 + 335*6
  have h12 : (2014 : ℝ) = (4 + ↑(335 : ℕ) * 6 : ℝ) := by
    norm_num
  rw [h12]
  specialize eq4 335
  norm_num at eq4 ⊢
  all_goals
    linarith [eq4]

theorem algebra_10865 {a b c d : ℤ} (h : ∀ x : ℝ, (x^2 + a * x + b) * (x^2 + c * x + d) = x^4 + x^3 - 2 * x^2 + 17 * x - 5) :
    a + b + c + d = 5 := by
  have eq1 := h 0
  have eq2 := h 1
  have eq3 := h (-1 : ℝ)
  have eq4 := h (2 : ℝ)
  have eq5 := h (-2 : ℝ)
  ring_nf at eq1 eq2 eq3 eq4 eq5
  have h1 : (b : ℝ) * (d : ℝ) = -5 := by
    nlinarith
  have h2 : (1 + (a : ℝ) + (b : ℝ)) * (1 + (c : ℝ) + (d : ℝ)) = 12 := by
    nlinarith
  have h3 : (1 - (a : ℝ) + (b : ℝ)) * (1 - (c : ℝ) + (d : ℝ)) = -24 := by
    nlinarith
  have h4 : (4 + 2 * (a : ℝ) + (b : ℝ)) * (4 + 2 * (c : ℝ) + (d : ℝ)) = 45 := by
    nlinarith
  have h5 : (4 - 2 * (a : ℝ) + (b : ℝ)) * (4 - 2 * (c : ℝ) + (d : ℝ)) = -39 := by
    nlinarith
  have h1' : b * d = -5 := by
    have h11 : (b : ℝ) * (d : ℝ) = -5 := h1
    exact_mod_cast h11
  have h2' : (1 + a + b) * (1 + c + d) = 12 := by
    have h22 : (1 + (a : ℝ) + (b : ℝ)) * (1 + (c : ℝ) + (d : ℝ)) = 12 := h2
    exact_mod_cast h22
  have h3' : (1 - a + b) * (1 - c + d) = -24 := by
    have h33 : (1 - (a : ℝ) + (b : ℝ)) * (1 - (c : ℝ) + (d : ℝ)) = -24 := h3
    exact_mod_cast h33
  have h4' : (4 + 2 * a + b) * (4 + 2 * c + d) = 45 := by
    have h44 : (4 + 2 * (a : ℝ) + (b : ℝ)) * (4 + 2 * (c : ℝ) + (d : ℝ)) = 45 := h4
    exact_mod_cast h44
  have h5' : (4 - 2 * a + b) * (4 - 2 * c + d) = -39 := by
    have h55 : (4 - 2 * (a : ℝ) + (b : ℝ)) * (4 - 2 * (c : ℝ) + (d : ℝ)) = -39 := h5
    exact_mod_cast h55
  have h7 : b = 1 ∨ b = -1 ∨ b = 5 ∨ b = -5 := by
    have h7 : b * d = -5 := h1'
    have h8 : b ∣ -5 := by
      use d
      all_goals linarith
    have h9 : b ∣ 5 := by
      exact Int.dvd_neg.mp h8
    have : b = 1 ∨ b = -1 ∨ b = 5 ∨ b = -5 := by
      have h10 : b ≤ 5 := by
        apply Int.le_of_dvd (by norm_num) h9
      have h11 : b ≥ -5 := by
        have h11 : -b ∣ 5 := by
          exact Int.neg_dvd.2 h9
        have h12 : -b ≤ 5 := by
          apply Int.le_of_dvd (by norm_num) h11
        omega
      interval_cases b <;> try { tauto }
    assumption
  rcases h7 with h7 | h7 | h7 | h7
  · -- b = 1
    have h8 : d = -5 := by
      rw [show b = 1 by linarith] at h1'
      have : (1 : ℤ) * d = -5 := by linarith
      omega
    rw [show d = -5 by linarith] at h2' h3' h4' h5'
    rw [show b = 1 by linarith] at h2' h3' h4' h5'
    have h8 : a + c = 1 := by
      nlinarith
    have h9 : a * c = 2 := by
      nlinarith
    have h10 : a ≤ 3 := by
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (a - 3 : ℤ), sq_nonneg (a + 2 : ℤ)]
    have h11 : a ≥ -1 := by
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (a - 3 : ℤ), sq_nonneg (a + 2 : ℤ)]
    interval_cases a <;> omega
  · -- b = -1
    have h8 : d = 5 := by
      rw [show b = -1 by linarith] at h1'
      have : (-1 : ℤ) * d = -5 := by linarith

theorem algebra_51013 {a : ℝ} (ha : a > 1) (h : 20 * a / (a ^ 2 + 1) = Real.sqrt 2) :

  have h1 : a ^ 2 + 1 > 0 := by

    field_simp [h1] at h ⊢

    calc

        rw [h2]
      _ = (Real.sqrt 2) ^ 2 * (a ^ 2 + 1) ^ 2 := by ring
      _ = 2 * (a ^ 2 + 1) ^ 2 := by
        rw [Real.sq_sqrt]
        all_goals nlinarith

  have h4 : a ^ 4 - 198 * a ^ 2 + 1 = 0 := by

            -- Compute the sum directly

            rw [← logb_mul (by norm_num) (by norm_num), ← logb_mul (by norm_num) (by norm_num), ← logb_mul (by norm_num) (by norm_num)]
            all_goals try { norm_num }
            all_goals try { native_decide }
        have h5 : (3 / 2 : ℝ) * (5 / 4 : ℝ) * (17 / 16 : ℝ) * (257 / 256 : ℝ) = (65535 / 32768 : ℝ) := by norm_num
        rw [h3, h4, h5]

          have h3 : logb 2 (2 : ℝ) = (1 : ℝ) := by

theorem algebra_325901 {X Y : Fin 2 → ℝ}

  (hXY : ∀ i, X i * Y i = 1) :
  (∑ i, X i * (1 / 2)) * (∑ i, Y i * (1 / 2)) ≤ 25 / 24 := by

  have h1 : 2 ≤ X 0 := by 
    have h := hX 0
    linarith 

  have h2 : X 0 ≤ 3 := by 
    have h := hX 0
    linarith

  have h3 : 2 ≤ X 1 := by 
    have h := hX 1
    linarith

  have h4 : X 1 ≤ 3 := by

    linarith

    apply hXY 0

    simp [Finset.sum_fin_eq_sum_range, Finset.sum_range_succ]
    <;> ring

    simp [Finset.sum_fin_eq_sum_range, Finset.sum_range_succ]
    <;> ring

  rw [h7, h8]

  have h80 : Y 0 = 1 / X 0 := by
    have hne1 : X 0 ≠ 0 := by 
      linarith [h1, h2]
    field_simp [hne1] at *
    <;> nlinarith [h5]

  have h81 : Y 1 = 1 / X 1 := by
    have hne1 : X 1 ≠ 0 := by 
      linarith [h3, h4]
    field_simp [hne1] at *
    <;> nlinarith [h6]

  rw [h80, h81]
  have h13 : 0 < X 0 := by linarith 
  have h14 : 0 < X 1 := by linarith

  have h9 : X 0 ≥ 2 := h1
  have h10 : X 0 ≤ 3 := h2
  have h11 : X 1 ≥ 2 := h3
  have h12 : X 1 ≤ 3 := h4

  have h9' : X 0 * X 1 > 0 := mul_pos (by linarith) (by linarith)

  have h20 : (X 0 + X 1) ^ 2 / (4 * X 0 * X 1) ≤ (25 / 24) := by

    have h21 : (X 0 + X 1) ^ 2 ≤ (25 / 6) * (X 0 * X 1) := by
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (X 0 - 2), sq_nonneg (X 1 - 3), sq_nonneg (X 0 - 3), sq_nonneg (X 1 - 2),

    have h22 : ((X 0 + X 1) / 2) * ((1 / X 0 + 1 / X 1) / 2) = (X 0 + X 1) ^ 2 / (4 * X 0 * X 1) := by 
      field_simp

theorem algebra_20652 :
    {r : ℝ | ∃ x y z : ℝ, x + y + z = 7 ∧ x ≥ 0 ∧ y ≥ 0 ∧ z ≥ 0 ∧ r = x * y * z} = Set.Icc 0 (343 / 27) := by 
  ext r
  simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_Icc]
  constructor
  · -- First direction: if r is in the image of f, then r is in [0, 343/27]
    rintro ⟨x, y, z, h_eq, hx, hy, hz, hr⟩
    have h1 : x * y * z ≥ 0 := by
      apply mul_nonneg
      apply mul_nonneg
      all_goals linarith
    have h2 : x * y * z ≤ 343 / 27 := by
      have h34 : x * y * z ≤ (7 / 3) ^ 3 := by
        have h4 : (x + y + z : ℝ) = 7 := by linarith
        have h5 : x * y * z ≤ ((x + y + z) / 3) ^ 3 := by
          nlinarith [sq_nonneg (x - y), sq_nonneg (y - z), sq_nonneg (z - x),
            sq_nonneg (x - (x + y + z) / 3), sq_nonneg (y - (x + y + z) / 3), sq_nonneg (z - (x + y + z) / 3),
            mul_nonneg (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ x by linarith) (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ y by linarith), 
            mul_nonneg (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ y by linarith) (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ z by linarith), 
            mul_nonneg (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ x by linarith) (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ z by linarith)]
        have h37 : ((x + y + z) / 3 : ℝ) = 7 / 3 := by linarith
        rw [h37] at h5
        linarith
      norm_num at h34 ⊢
      linarith
    constructor
    · -- Show r ≥ 0
      nlinarith [hr, h1]
    · -- Show r ≤ 343/27
      nlinarith [hr, h2]
  · -- Second direction: if r is in [0, 343/27], then r is in the image of f.
    rintro ⟨hr1, hr2⟩
    have h12 : r ≤ 343 / 27 := by linarith
    have h34 : ∃ x y z : ℝ, x + y + z = 7 ∧ x ≥ 0 ∧ y ≥ 0 ∧ z ≥ 0 ∧ r = x * y * z := by

theorem algebra_214044 (α β A : ℝ) (h₀ : abs A > 1) (h₁ : Real.sin α = A * Real.sin (α + β)) :

theorem algebra_313594 {x : ℝ} (hx : x > 0) (h : x^2 + 1/x^2 = 7) :

theorem algebra_307154 {a b c : ℝ} (h₀ : a + b = 8) (h₁ : a * b - c ^ 2 + 8 * Real.sqrt 2 * c = 48) :
    ∃ x₁ x₂, x₁ ^ 2 * b + c * x₁ - a = 0 ∧ x₂ ^ 2 * b + c * x₂ - a = 0 ∧
    x₁ = (-Real.sqrt 2 + Real.sqrt 6) / 2 ∧ x₂ = (-Real.sqrt 2 - Real.sqrt 6) / 2 := by
  have h2 : b = 8 - a := by linarith
  rw [h2] at h₁
  have h3 : (a - 4) ^ 2 + (c - 4 * Real.sqrt 2) ^ 2 = 0 := by
    nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2 by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2),
      Real.sqrt_nonneg 2]
  have ha : a = 4 := by
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (a - 4), sq_nonneg (c - 4 * Real.sqrt 2)]
  have hc : c = 4 * Real.sqrt 2 := by
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (a - 4), sq_nonneg (c - 4 * Real.sqrt 2)]
  have hb : b = 4 := by
    linarith [h₀, ha]
  use (-Real.sqrt 2 + Real.sqrt 6) / 2, (-Real.sqrt 2 - Real.sqrt 6) / 2
  constructor
  · -- Show that x₁ is a root of the quadratic equation

    nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2 by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2),
      Real.sq_sqrt (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ (6 : ℝ) by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (6 : ℝ)),

      Real.sq_sqrt (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ (6 : ℝ) by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (6 : ℝ)),
      mul_self_nonneg (Real.sqrt 2 + Real.sqrt 6)]
  constructor
  · -- Show that x₁ equals (-√2 + √6)/2
    rfl
  · -- Show that x₂ equals (-√2 - √6)/2
    rfl

theorem algebra_145405 {a : ℕ → ℤ} (ha : a 0 = -1) (ha1 : a 1 = -3) (ha2 : a 2 = -5)
    (ha3 : a 3 = 5) (h : ∀ n ≥ 4, a n = 8 * a (n - 1) - 22 * a (n - 2) + 24 * a (n - 3) - 9 * a (n - 4)) :

formal_proof:

theorem algebra_145405 {a : ℕ → ℤ} (ha : a 0 = -1) (ha1 : a 1 = -3) (ha2 : a 2 = -5)
    (ha3 : a 3 = 5) (h : ∀ n ≥ 4, a n = 8 * a (n - 1) - 22 * a (n - 2) + 24 * a (n - 3) - 9 * a (n - 4)) :
    ∀ n, a n = 2 + n - 3 ^ (n + 1) + n * 3 ^ n := by
  intro n
  induction' n using Nat.strongRecOn with n ih
  cases n with
  | zero =>
    simp [ha]
    <;> ring
  | succ n =>
    cases n with
    | zero =>
      simp [ha1]
      <;> ring
    | succ n =>
      cases n with
      | zero =>
        simp [ha2]
        <;> ring
      | succ n =>
        cases n with
        | zero =>
          simp [ha3]
          <;> ring
        | succ n =>
          have eq1 := ih (n + 3) (by linarith)
          have eq2 := ih (n + 2) (by linarith)
          have eq3 := ih (n + 1) (by linarith)
          have eq4 := ih (n) (by linarith)
          specialize h (n + 4) (by omega)
          simp [h, eq1, eq2, eq3, eq4]
          all_goals
            ring_nf
            <;> omega

theorem algebra_206615 (a b c : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (hc : 0 < c)
    (h1 : a^2 + b^2 - c^2 = √3 * a * b) (h2 : a^2 - b^2 + c^2 = √2 * a * c) :
    b / c = √2 := by

  have h_eq1 : 2 * a = √3 * b + √2 * c := by
    have h3 : 2 * a^2 = √3 * a * b + √2 * a * c := by
      nlinarith
    have ha_pos : a ≠ 0 := by linarith
    apply (mul_left_inj' ha_pos).mp
    linarith

  have h_eq2 : √3 * a * b + c^2 - b^2 = √2 * a * c + b^2 - c^2 := by
    have h3 : a^2 + b^2 - c^2 = √3 * a * b := by linarith
    have h4 : a^2 - b^2 + c^2 = √2 * a * c := by linarith
    nlinarith

  have eq_a : a = (√3 * b + √2 * c) / 2 := by
    have : a = (√3 * b + √2 * c) / 2 := by
      linarith
    linarith

  rw [eq_a] at h_eq2

  have h_eq3 : b ^ 2 = 2 * c ^ 2 := by
    nlinarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg 3, Real.sqrt_nonneg 2, Real.sq_sqrt (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ 3 by norm_num), Real.sq_sqrt (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2 by norm_num), mul_pos (show 0 < b by linarith) (show 0 < c by linarith)]

  have h_eq4 : b ^ 2 = 2 * c ^ 2 := h_eq3

  have h_eq5 : b = Real.sqrt 2 * c := by
    have h3 : c > 0 := by assumption
    have h4 : b ^ 2 - 2 * c ^ 2 = 0 := by linarith

    · -- case $b + \sqrt{2}c = 0$

      nlinarith [Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (show 0 < (2 : ℝ) by norm_num), mul_pos (show 0 < (2 : ℝ) by norm_num) (show 0 < c by linarith)]

  have : b / c = Real.sqrt 2 := by
    have c_pos : c ≠ 0 := by linarith
    field_simp at *
    nlinarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg 2, Real.sq_sqrt (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ (2 : ℝ) by norm_num), mul_pos (show 0 < b by linarith) (show 0 < c by linarith)]

theorem algebra_94057 (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hf : ∀ x y, |f x - f y| ≤ 1 / 2 * |x - y|)
    (h300 : f 300 = f 900) :
    f (f 800) - f (f 400) ≤ 50 := by 
  have h1 := hf 800 900
  have h2 := hf 400 300
  have h3 := hf 800 400
  have h4 := hf (f 800) (f 400)
  have h5 := hf 800 800
  have h6 := hf 400 400
  have h7 : |f 800 - f 900| ≤ 1 / 2 * |(800 : ℝ) - 900| := by
    simpa using h1
  have h8 : |f 400 - f 300| ≤ 1 / 2 * |(400 : ℝ) - 300| := by
    simpa using h2
  have h9 : |f 800 - f 400| ≤ 1 / 2 * |(800 : ℝ) - 400| := by
    simpa using h3
  have h10 : |f (f 800) - f (f 400)| ≤ 1 / 2 * |f 800 - f 400| := by
    simpa using h4
  have h800_900 : |f 800 - f 900| ≤ 50 := by
    norm_num at h7 ⊢
    linarith [h7]
  have h400_300 : |f 400 - f 300| ≤ 50 := by
    norm_num at h8 ⊢

theorem algebra_5172 {f : ℝ → ℝ} (h : Function.Injective f)
  (h1 : ∀ x y, f (x * y) = f x * f y) (h2 : ∀ x y, f (x + y) = f x + f y) :

formal_proof:

theorem algebra_5172 {f : ℝ → ℝ} (h : Function.Injective f)
  (h1 : ∀ x y, f (x * y) = f x * f y) (h2 : ∀ x y, f (x + y) = f x + f y) :
  ∀ x y, x < y → f x < f y := by
  
  have h3 : f 0 = 0 := by
    have h4 := h2 0 0
    simp at h4
    linarith
  
  have h4 : f 1 = 1 := by
    have h5 := h1 1 1
    simp at h5
    have h6 : f 1 * (f 1 - 1) = 0 := by 
      linarith 
    cases' (mul_eq_zero.mp h6) with h7 h8
    · -- Case where f 1 = 0
      have h9 : f 1 = f 0 := by 
        linarith [h3, h7]
      have h10 : (1 : ℝ) = (0 : ℝ) := by 
        exact h h9
      linarith 
    · -- Case where f 1 - 1 = 0
      linarith
  
  have h5 : ∀ x, f (-x) = - f x := by
    intro x 
    have h6 := h2 x (-x)
    simp [h3] at h6 
    have h7 : f (-x) = - f x := by linarith 
    exact h7
  
  have h6 : ∀ x > 0, f x > 0 := by 
    intro x hx
    have h7 : ∃ s > 0, s ^ 2 = x := by 
      use Real.sqrt x 
      constructor 
      · -- Show that sqrt x > 0 when x > 0
        positivity 
      · -- Show that (sqrt x) ^ 2 = x when x > 0
        rw [Real.sq_sqrt]
        linarith 
    rcases h7 with ⟨s, hs, h8⟩ 
    have h9 := h1 s s 
    rw [show s * s = x by linarith [h8]] at h9 
    have h10 : f x = (f s) ^ 2 := by 
      linarith 
    have h11 : f s ≠ 0 := by 
      by_contra h12 
      have h13 : f s = f 0 := by 
        linarith [h3, h12] 
      have h14 : s = (0 : ℝ) := by 
        exact h h13 
      linarith [hs, h14] 
    have h15 : (f s) ^ 2 > 0 := by 
      exact sq_pos_of_ne_zero h11 
    linarith [h10, h15]
  
  intro x y hxy 
  have h8 : y - x > 0 := by linarith 
  have h9 : f (y - x) > 0 := h6 (y - x) h8 
  have h10 : f y = f x + f (y - x) := by 
    specialize h2 x (y - x) 
    have : x + (y - x) = y := by ring 
    rw [this] at h2 
    linarith 
  linarith [h10, h9]

    push_neg at h7

Analysis: From $y \leqslant|x|$, we know that when $x \geqslant 0$, $y \leqslant x$; when $x<0$, $y \leqslant -x$. Therefore, these two cases should be discussed separately. -/
theorem algebra_324043 {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : f = λ x => x^2 / 10 - x / 10 + 9 / 5) :

theorem algebra_324043 {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : f = λ x => x^2 / 10 - x / 10 + 9 / 5) :
    ∀ x, f x ≤ abs x ↔ 2 ≤ x ∧ x ≤ 9 ∨ -6 ≤ x ∧ x ≤ -3 := by
  intro x
  constructor
  · -- Assume f x ≤ |x|
    intro h
    rw [hf] at h
    by_cases h1 : x ≥ 0
    · -- If x ≥ 0, then |x| = x
      rw [abs_of_nonneg h1] at h
      have h2 : x ^ 2 / 10 - x / 10 + 9 / 5 ≤ x := by linarith [h]
      have h3 : x ^ 2 - 11 * x + 18 ≤ 0 := by
        nlinarith
      have h4 : 2 ≤ x := by
        nlinarith [sq_nonneg (x - 2), sq_nonneg (x - 9)]
      have h5 : x ≤ 9 := by
        nlinarith [sq_nonneg (x - 2), sq_nonneg (x - 9)]
      left
      constructor
      · linarith
      · linarith
    · -- If x < 0, then |x| = -x

      have h2 : x ^ 2 / 10 - x / 10 + 9 / 5 ≤ -x := by linarith [h]
      have h3 : x ^ 2 + 9 * x + 18 ≤ 0 := by
        nlinarith
      have h4 : -6 ≤ x := by
        nlinarith [sq_nonneg (x + 6), sq_nonneg (x + 3)]
      have h5 : x ≤ -3 := by
        nlinarith [sq_nonneg (x + 6), sq_nonneg (x + 3)]
      right
      constructor
      · linarith
      · linarith
  · -- Assume 2 ≤ x ∧ x ≤ 9 ∨ -6 ≤ x ∧ x ≤ -3, prove f x ≤ |x|
    rintro (h | h)

theorem algebra_7128 (x : ℝ) (hx1 : x^2 - 5 * x + 1 ≥ 0) (hx2 : 8 * x - x^2 - 12 ≥ 0)
    (hx3 : 3 * x - 11 ≥ 0) :
    Real.sqrt (x^2 - 5 * x + 1) + Real.sqrt (8 * x - x^2 - 12) = Real.sqrt (3 * x - 11) ↔
    x = (5 + Real.sqrt 21) / 2 ∨ x = 6 := by
formal_proof:

theorem algebra_7128 (x : ℝ) (hx1 : x^2 - 5 * x + 1 ≥ 0) (hx2 : 8 * x - x^2 - 12 ≥ 0)
    (hx3 : 3 * x - 11 ≥ 0) :
    Real.sqrt (x^2 - 5 * x + 1) + Real.sqrt (8 * x - x^2 - 12) = Real.sqrt (3 * x - 11) ↔
    x = (5 + Real.sqrt 21) / 2 ∨ x = 6 := by 

  constructor
  · -- Assume the equation, prove the disjunction of the two roots
    intro h_eq
    have h1 : Real.sqrt (x^2 - 5 * x + 1) ≥ 0 := by positivity
    have h2 : Real.sqrt (8 * x - x^2 - 12) ≥ 0 := by positivity
    have h3 : Real.sqrt (3 * x - 11) ≥ 0 := by positivity
    have h_eq1 : (Real.sqrt (x^2 - 5 * x + 1) + Real.sqrt (8 * x - x^2 - 12)) ^ 2 = (Real.sqrt (3 * x - 11)) ^ 2 := by 
      rw [h_eq]
    have h_eq2 : (Real.sqrt (x^2 - 5 * x + 1)) ^ 2 + (Real.sqrt (8 * x - x^2 - 12)) ^ 2 + 2 * (Real.sqrt (x^2 - 5 * x + 1) * Real.sqrt (8 * x - x^2 - 12)) = (3 * x - 11) := by
      have h_eq3 : (Real.sqrt (3 * x - 11)) ^ 2 = 3 * x - 11 := by 
        rw [Real.sq_sqrt]
        linarith 
      nlinarith [h_eq1, h_eq3, Real.sq_sqrt (show x^2 - 5 * x + 1 ≥ 0 by linarith), Real.sq_sqrt (show 8 * x - x^2 - 12 ≥ 0 by linarith)]
    have h_eq3 : (Real.sqrt (x^2 - 5 * x + 1)) ^ 2 = x^2 - 5 * x + 1 := Real.sq_sqrt (by linarith)
    have h_eq4 : (Real.sqrt (8 * x - x^2 - 12)) ^ 2 = 8 * x - x^2 - 12 := Real.sq_sqrt (by linarith)
    rw [h_eq3, h_eq4] at h_eq2
    have h_eq5 : 2 * (Real.sqrt (x^2 - 5 * x + 1) * Real.sqrt (8 * x - x^2 - 12)) = 0 := by 
      nlinarith 
    have h_eq6 : Real.sqrt (x^2 - 5 * x + 1) * Real.sqrt (8 * x - x^2 - 12) = 0 := by 
      linarith [h_eq5, h1, h2, h3]
    cases' (mul_eq_zero.mp h_eq6) with h_a h_b
    · -- Case where sqrt(x^2 -5x +1) = 0 
      have h_eq7 : Real.sqrt (x^2 - 5 * x + 1) = 0 := by
        linarith 
      have h_eq8 : x^2 - 5 * x + 1 = 0 := by 
        rw [Real.sqrt_eq_zero (by linarith)] at h_eq7 
        linarith
      have h4 : x^2 - 5 * x + 1 = (x - (5 + Real.sqrt 21) / 2) * (x - (5 - Real.sqrt 21) / 2) := by
        nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ (21 : ℝ) by norm_num), Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (show (0 : ℝ) < (21 : ℝ) by norm_num)]
      rw [h4] at h_eq8
      cases' (mul_eq_zero.mp h_eq8) with h_a h_b
      · -- Case where x - (5 + Real.sqrt 21) / 2 = 0 
        left
        linarith
      · -- Case where x - (5 - Real.sqrt 21) / 2 = 0 
        right
        nlinarith [Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (show (0 : ℝ) < (21 : ℝ) by norm_num ), Real.sq_sqrt (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ (21 : ℝ) by norm_num ) ] 
    · -- Case where sqrt(8x -x^2 -12) = 0 
      have h_eq9 : Real.sqrt (8 * x - x^2 - 12) = 0 := by 
        linarith 
      have h_eq10 : 8 * x - x^2 - 12 = 0 := by 
        rw [Real.sqrt_eq_zero (by linarith)] at h_eq9 
        linarith
      have h5 : 8 * x - x^2 - 12 = 0 := h_eq10 
      have h6 : x^2 - 8 * x + 12 = 0 := by nlinarith
      have h7 : (x - 2) * (x - 6) = 0 := by 
        nlinarith [h6]
      cases' (mul_eq_zero.mp h7) with h8 h9
      · -- Case where x - 2 = 0 
        nlinarith [Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (show (0 : ℝ) < (3 : ℝ) by norm_num ), Real.sq_sqrt (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ (3 : ℝ) by norm_num ) ]
      · -- Case where x - 6 = 0 
        right
        linarith
  · -- Prove that the solutions satisfy the equation
    rintro (h | h)
    · -- Case where x = (5 + Real.sqrt 21) / 2 
      have h1 : x ^ 2 - 5 * x + 1 = 0 := by 
        nlinarith [Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (show (0 : ℝ) < (21 : ℝ) by norm_num ), Real.sq_sqrt (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ (21 : ℝ) by norm_num ) ]
      have h2 : Real.sqrt (x ^ 2 - 5 * x + 1) = 0 := by 
        rw [show x ^ 2 - 5 * x + 1 = (0 : ℝ) by nlinarith [Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (show (0 : ℝ) < (21 : ℝ) by norm_num ), Real.sq_sqrt (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ (21 : ℝ) by norm_num ) ] ]
        simp
      have h3 : Real.sqrt (8 * x - x^2 - 12) = Real.sqrt (3 * x - 11) := by 
        have h4 : 8 * x - x^2 - 12 = 3 * x - 11 := by 
          nlinarith [Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (show (0 : ℝ) < (21 : ℝ) by norm_num ), Real.sq_sqrt (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ (21 : ℝ) by norm_num  ) ]
        rw [h4]
      rw [h2, h3]
      all_goals linarith
    · -- Case where x = 6 
      have h4 : x = 6 := by linarith
      rw [h4]
      have h5 : Real.sqrt (6^2 - 5 * (6 : ℝ) + 1) = Real.sqrt 7 := by norm_num [Real.sqrt_eq_iff_sq_eq]
      have h6 : Real.sqrt (8 * (6 : ℝ) - 6^2 - 12) = 0 := by norm_num [Real.sqrt_eq_zero]
      have h7 : Real.sqrt (3 * (6 : ℝ) - 11) = Real.sqrt 7 := by norm_num [Real.sqrt_eq_iff_sq_eq]
      rw [h5, h6, h7]
      all_goals norm_num

/- Find the matrix $\mathbf{L} = \begin{pmatrix} a & 0 \\ c & d \end{pmatrix}$ such that $a > 0,$ $d > 0,$ and
\[\begin{pmatrix} a & 0 \\ c & d \end{pmatrix} \begin{pmatrix} a & c \\ 0 & d \end{pmatrix} = \begin{pmatrix} 4 & -6 \\ -6 & 34 \end{pmatrix}.\] -/
theorem calculus_22162 {a c d : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hd : 0 < d)
    (h : !![a, 0; c, d] * !![a, c; 0, d] = !![4, -6; -6, 34]) :

formal_proof:

theorem calculus_22162 {a c d : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hd : 0 < d)
    (h : !![a, 0; c, d] * !![a, c; 0, d] = !![4, -6; -6, 34]) :
    a = 2 ∧ c = -3 ∧ d = 5 := by
  have he11 : a^2 = 4 := by 
    have eq11 := congr_arg (λ m => m 0 0) h
    simp [Matrix.mul_apply] at eq11 
    nlinarith
  have he12 : a * c = -6 := by 
    have eq12 := congr_arg (λ m => m 0 1) h
    simp [Matrix.mul_apply] at eq12 
    linarith
  have he21 : a * c = -6 := by 
    have eq21 := congr_arg (λ m => m 1 0) h
    simp [Matrix.mul_apply] at eq21 
    linarith
  have he22 : c^2 + d^2 = 34 := by 
    have eq22 := congr_arg (λ m => m 1 1) h
    simp [Matrix.mul_apply] at eq22 
    nlinarith
  have ha2 : a = 2 := by
    nlinarith
  have hc3 : c = -3 := by
    rw [ha2] at he12
    nlinarith
  have hd5 : d = 5 := by
    rw [hc3] at he22
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (d - 5)]
  exact ⟨ha2, hc3, hd5⟩

    have h7 : cos y > 0 := by

    linarith
  have htan : tan y = sin y / cos y := by rw [tan_eq_sin_div_cos]
  have htanx : tan x = sin x / cos x := by rw [tan_eq_sin_div_cos]
  rw [htan, htanx] at h

    have h8 : cos x ≠ 0 := h2
    have h9 : cos y ≠ 0 := h5

    linarith

    have h_eq4 : sin (y - x) = sin y * cos x - cos y * sin x := by

    linarith

  have h12 : y - x = Real.pi / 2 - y := by
    have h13 : sin (y - x) = sin (Real.pi / 2 - y) := h8

    have hx2 : x = 3 := by
      linarith [hz2, h5]
    have hy2 : y = 3 := by
      linarith [hz2, h6]

  have h2 : q ≤ 5 := by linarith [h]
  have h3 : q ≥ 2 := by
    by_contra h3
    push_neg at h3
    have h4 : q < 2 := by linarith
    interval_cases q <;> norm_num at hq <;> try { contradiction }
    all_goals omega

  have h4 : q = 2 ∨ q = 3 ∨ q = 5 := by
    interval_cases q <;> norm_num at hq <;> try { tauto }
  
  rcases h4 with hq2 | hq3 | hq5
  · -- Case q = 2
    have hq2' : q = 2 := by omega
    have hp9 : 3 * p = 27 := by
      rw [hq2'] at h
      omega
    have hp9' : p = 9 := by
      linarith [hp9]
    rw [hp9'] at hp
    norm_num at hp
    all_goals try contradiction
  · -- Case q = 3
    have hq3' : q = 3 := by omega
    have h1' : 3 * p = 20 := by 
      rw [hq3'] at h
      omega
    omega
  · -- Case q = 5
    have hq5' : q = 5 := by omega
    have eq1 : 3 * p = 6 := by
      rw [hq5'] at h
      omega
    have hp2 : p = 2 := by 
      omega
    calc 
      (p + 1) * (q - 1) = (2 + 1) * (5 - 1) := by rw [hp2, hq5']
      _ = 12 := by norm_num

/- Problem 1. During the school year, Kosta took several math tests and scored a certain number of points. If Kosta scores 89 points on the next math test, then the average number of points earned from the tests will be 91. However, if on the next test he scores 64, then the average number of points will be 86. How many math tests has Kosta taken so far? -/
theorem algebra_235947 (n : ℕ) (h : n > 0) (x : ℝ) (hx : x ≠ 0)
    (h1 : (n * x + 89) / (n + 1) = 91) (h2 : (n * x + 64) / (n + 1) = 86) :
    n = 4 := by
formal_proof:

theorem algebra_235947 (n : ℕ) (h : n > 0) (x : ℝ) (hx : x ≠ 0)
    (h1 : (n * x + 89) / (n + 1) = 91) (h2 : (n * x + 64) / (n + 1) = 86) :
    n = 4 := by
  have eq1 : (n : ℝ) > (0 : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast h
  have eq2 : (n + 1 : ℝ) > (0 : ℝ) := by
    have hn : (n : ℝ) > (0 : ℝ) := eq1
    nlinarith
  have eq3 : (n * x + 89 : ℝ) = 91 * ((n + 1) : ℝ) := by
    have h1' : (n + 1 : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by linarith
    field_simp at h1 ⊢
    linarith
  have eq4 : (n * x + 64 : ℝ) = 86 * ((n + 1) : ℝ) := by
    have h2' : (n + 1 : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by linarith
    field_simp at h2 ⊢
    linarith
  have eq5 : (n : ℝ) * x - 91 * (n : ℝ) - 2 = 0 := by
    nlinarith
  have eq6 : (n : ℝ) * x - 86 * (n : ℝ) - 22 = 0 := by
    nlinarith
  have eq7 : (n : ℝ) = 4 := by
    nlinarith
  have hn : n = 4 := by
    exact_mod_cast eq7
  exact hn

/- 2. The numbers $a, b, c$ and $d$ satisfy the relation $a c=2 b+2 d$. Prove that at least one of the quadratic polynomials $x^{2}+a x+b$ and $x^{2}+c x+d$ has a root. -/
theorem algebra_224796 {a b c d : ℝ} (h : a * c = 2 * b + 2 * d) :
    ∃ x, x ^ 2 + a * x + b = 0 ∨ x ^ 2 + c * x + d = 0 := by
formal_proof:
import Mathlib

theorem algebra_224796 {a b c d : ℝ} (h : a * c = 2 * b + 2 * d) :
    ∃ x, x ^ 2 + a * x + b = 0 ∨ x ^ 2 + c * x + d = 0 := by
  by_cases h1 : a ^ 2 - 4 * b ≥ 0
  · -- If $a^2 - 4b \geq 0$, then $x^2 + ax + b = 0$ has a root.
    use (-a + Real.sqrt (a ^ 2 - 4 * b)) / 2
    left
    have h2 : (Real.sqrt (a ^ 2 - 4 * b)) ^ 2 = a ^ 2 - 4 * b := by
      rw [Real.sq_sqrt]
      linarith
    nlinarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg (a ^ 2 - 4 * b), h2]
  · -- Assume h1 is false, so $a^2 - 4b < 0$, then we must have $c^2 - 4d \geq 0$
    have h2 : c ^ 2 - 4 * d ≥ 0 := by
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (a - c), h]
    -- Now use the quadratic formula for $x^2 + c x + d = 0$
    use (-c + Real.sqrt (c ^ 2 - 4 * d)) / 2
    right
    have h3 : (Real.sqrt (c ^ 2 - 4 * d)) ^ 2 = c ^ 2 - 4 * d := by
      rw [Real.sq_sqrt]
      linarith
    nlinarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg (c ^ 2 - 4 * d), h3]

/- 26 (1268). Prove that $p^{2}-1$ is divisible by 24 if $p$ is a prime number greater than 3. -/
theorem number_theory_197105 (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) (h : 3 < p) :
    24 ∣ p^2 - 1 := by
formal_proof:
import Mathlib

theorem number_theory_197105 (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) (h : 3 < p) :
    24 ∣ p^2 - 1 := by

  have h1 : p % 2 = 1 := by
    have h2 : p % 2 = 1 ∨ p % 2 = 0 := by omega
    rcases h2 with (h2 | h2)
    · exact h2
    · -- if p % 2 = 0 then p is not prime
      have h3 : p ≥ 4 := by linarith
      have h4 : ¬p.Prime := by
        apply Nat.not_prime_of_dvd_of_lt (show 2 ∣ p by omega)
        all_goals omega
      contradiction
  
  have h8 : (p ^ 2) % 8 = 1 := by
    have h5 : p % 2 = 1 := h1
    have h6 : p % 8 = 1 ∨ p % 8 = 3 ∨ p % 8 = 5 ∨ p % 8 = 7 := by
      omega
    rcases h6 with (h6 | h6 | h6 | h6)
    · -- p ≡ 1 [MOD 8]
      simp [Nat.pow_mod, h6]
    · -- p ≡ 3 [MOD 8]
      simp [Nat.pow_mod, h6]
    · -- p ≡ 5 [MOD 8]
      simp [Nat.pow_mod, h6]
    · -- p ≡ 7 [MOD 8]
      simp [Nat.pow_mod, h6]

  have h2 : p % 3 = 1 ∨ p % 3 = 2 := by
    have h3 : p % 3 = 0 ∨ p % 3 = 1 ∨ p % 3 = 2 := by omega
    rcases h3 with (h3 | h3 | h3)
    · -- if p % 3 = 0 then p is not prime
      have h4 : p ≥ 4 := by linarith
      have h5 : ¬p.Prime := by
        apply Nat.not_prime_of_dvd_of_lt (show 3 ∣ p by omega)
        all_goals omega
      contradiction
    · exact Or.inl h3
    · exact Or.inr h3

  have h3 : (p ^ 2) % 3 = 1 := by
    have h4 : p % 3 = 1 ∨ p % 3 = 2 := h2
    rcases h4 with (h4 | h4)
    · -- p ≡ 1 [MOD 3]
      simp [Nat.pow_mod, h4]
    · -- p ≡ 2 [MOD 3]
      simp [Nat.pow_mod, h4]

  have h4 : (p ^ 2) % 8 = 1 := h8
  have h5 : (p ^ 2) % 3 = 1 := h3
  
  omega

/- $1.41 x, y, z$ are pairwise distinct integers. Prove that $(x-y)^{5}+(y-z)^{5}+$ $(z-x)^{5}$ is divisible by $5(y-z)(z-x)(x-y)$.
(2nd All-Russian Mathematical Olympiad, 1962) -/
theorem algebra_168394 (x y z : ℤ) (h : x ≠ y ∧ y ≠ z ∧ z ≠ x) :
    5 * (y - z) * (z - x) * (x - y) ∣ (x - y)^5 + (y - z)^5 + (z - x)^5 := by
formal_proof:
import Mathlib

theorem algebra_168394 (x y z : ℤ) (h : x ≠ y ∧ y ≠ z ∧ z ≠ x) :
    5 * (y - z) * (z - x) * (x - y) ∣ (x - y)^5 + (y - z)^5 + (z - x)^5 := by
  have eq1 : (x - y)^5 + (y - z)^5 + (z - x)^5 =
      5 * (y - z) * (z - x) * (x - y) * (x^2 + y^2 + z^2 - x * y - y * z - z * x) := by
    ring
  rw [eq1]
  -- once written as $5 * (y - z) * (z - x) * (x - y)$ multiplied by some polynomial, the divisibility follows.
  use x^2 + y^2 + z^2 - x * y - y * z - z * x
  all_goals ring
